title: Surface Mount PM Controller
text: 用于感应电机的基于转矩的内部磁场定向控制器，带有可选的外环转速控制器，输入 6 路、输出 3 路；按 {Parameterize losses by} 指定类型 Single efficiency；{Control Type} 控制 Speed、{Stator resistance, Rs} 指定电阻、{Stator leakage inductance, Lls} 指定电感、{Rotor resistance, Rr} 指定电阻、{Rotor leakage inductance, Llr} 指定电感、{Rotor magnetizing inductance, Lm} 指定电感、{Number of pole pairs, PolePairs} 指定极数、{Physical inertia, viscous damping, static friction, Mechanical} 指定电机的机械属性、{Rated synchronous speed, Frate} 指定电机频率、{Rated line to line voltage RMS, Vrate} 指定电机电压、{Rated slip, Srate} 指定电机转差速度、{Calculate Rated Stator Flux Current} 指定派生参数、{D-axis rated current, Isd_0} 指定派生、{Q-axis rated current, Isq_0} 指定派生、{Torque at rated current, Tem} 指定派生、{Bandwidth of the current regulator, EV_current} 指定带宽、{Sample time for the torque control, Tst} 指定时间 5e-5、{Calculate Current Regulator Gains} 指定派生参数、{D and Q axis proportional gain, Kp} 指定派生、{D and Q axis integral gain, Ki} 指定派生、{Bandwidth of the motion controller, EV_motion} 指定带宽、{Bandwidth of the state filter, EV_sf} 指定带宽、{Calculate Speed Regulator Gains} 指定派生参数、{Proportional gain, ba} 指定派生、{Angular gain, Ksa} 指定派生、{Rotational gain, Kisa} 指定派生、{Speed regulation time constant, Ksf} 指定派生、{Inertia compensation, Jcomp} 指定派生、{Viscous damping compensation, Fv} 指定派生、{Static friction, Fs} 指定派生、{Overall inverter efficiency, eff} 指定常量、{Vector of speeds (w) for tabulated loss, w_loss_bp} 指定断点、{Vector of torques (T) for tabulated loss, T_loss_bp} 指定断点、{Corresponding losses, losses_table} 指定表、{Vector of speeds (w) for tabulated efficiency, w_eff_bp} 指定断点、{Vector of torques (T) for tabulated efficiency, T_eff_bp} 指定断点、{Corresponding efficiency, efficiency_table} 指定表，按实例取值。
